# Planck.Headless v0.1.11 - Table of Contents

> Headless core for the Planck coding agent — config, resources, and session lifecycle

## Pages

- [Planck.Headless](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Planck.Headless](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/Planck.Headless.md): The headless core of the Planck coding agent.
- [Planck.Headless.Config](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/Planck.Headless.Config.md): Resolved runtime configuration for `planck_headless`.
- [Planck.Headless.Config.Models](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/Planck.Headless.Config.Models.md): Skogsra type for the models list in config.json.
- [Planck.Headless.Config.PathList](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/Planck.Headless.Config.PathList.md): Skogsra type for path lists set via environment variables.
- [Planck.Headless.Config.Providers](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/Planck.Headless.Config.Providers.md): Skogsra type for the providers map in config.json.
- [Planck.Headless.ResourceStore](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/Planck.Headless.ResourceStore.md): GenServer started at application boot that holds the loaded resources —
the single source of truth for skills, teams, and available models.
- [Planck.Headless.Secrets](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/Planck.Headless.Secrets.md): Dispatch module for secret storage.
- [Planck.Headless.Secrets.EnvFile](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/Planck.Headless.Secrets.EnvFile.md): Default `Planck.Agent.Secrets` implementation that reads and writes
API keys and service rules to `.planck/.env` and `~/.planck/.env`.
- [Planck.Headless.SessionName](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/Planck.Headless.SessionName.md): Generates and sanitizes human-readable session names in `<adjective>-<noun>` format.
- [Planck.Headless.SidecarManager](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/Planck.Headless.SidecarManager.md): Manages the optional sidecar OTP application.
- [Planck.Headless.Watcher](https://planck-headless.hexdocs.pm/Planck.Headless.Watcher.md): Watches the configured skill, team, and config directories for file changes
and calls `ResourceStore.reload/0` so running agents pick up updated skill
descriptions and configuration without restarting.
